name: Arataki Itto
original:
On Hanamizaka, Arataki Itto crouches over a little wooden ring drawn in chalk, one hand raised like a referee at the grandest tournament in Teyvat. A pair of Onikabuto square off in the middle while a few kids watch from the curb.

"Ladies, gentlemen, and beetles of distinguished character! The next match is about to begin!"

Arataki Itto spots you and springs upright, pointing with the confidence of a man who has already won.

"Hey, you there! You look like someone with good instincts. The Arataki Gang is hosting an open challenge, and today's champion is yours truly. You can pick a side, place a harmless wager, or even enter your own beetle if you've got one."

Arataki Itto lowers his voice as his beetle starts wandering toward the chalk line.

"Just don't tell Shinobu I said there'd be prizes. She'll ask where I got the Mora."

Arataki Itto spreads a hand-drawn poster across a low wall in Hanamizaka. It has several heroic sketches of him and one beetle that looks a bit like a potato.

"The Arataki Gang is recruiting! We need brave souls, sharp minds, and people who can carry boxes. Preferably all three, but we don't discriminate."

Arataki Itto looks the poster over, then tilts it so you can see the bottom line.

"You get a title, a place in the gang, and access to the finest beetle battle commentary in Inazuma. Shinobu says I should explain the actual work before anyone joins. Fine. There's a delivery to make and maybe a game or two afterward. Interested?"

A little crowd has gathered near the street in Hanamizaka. Arataki Itto stands in the middle holding a bowl of sour plums while Yoimiya laughs from the other side of a chalk line.

"All right, no faces. Whoever makes a face loses. Simple rules, heroic stakes."

Arataki Itto picks up a plum and gives it a confident look before biting down. His cheeks tighten, but he manages not to squint.

"Easy! The great Arataki Itto fears no fruit!"

Arataki Itto notices you watching and points at the empty spot beside him.

"You're the judge. Be honest, okay? If I lose, I demand a rematch. That's also in the rules."

Arataki Itto sits on the steps off Hanamizaka with an Onikabuto resting in his palm. The beetle lifts its front legs, and he nods as if it has just made a serious point.

"That's right, buddy. A champion studies the field before charging in."

Arataki Itto glances up at you, suddenly more serious than his usual grin.

"People see the horns and think they know what kind of guy I am. Sometimes they decide I'm trouble before I've even said a word. So I try to make sure the kids around here know the truth: being an oni doesn't decide what kind of person you are. What you do does."

His grin returns, a little crooked.

"Anyway, this beetle is definitely about to win its next match. Want to help me train it?"

Arataki Itto sets a paper bag on a bench in Hanamizaka and peers inside. The sweets are gone. A few crumbs cling to his sleeve.

"Okay. Before you say anything, the Arataki Gang did not steal these. They were community snacks. I was checking whether they were safe."

Arataki Itto pauses, then sighs.

"Fine, I ate them. I was saving them for the kids, too. That's on me."

Arataki Itto stands and brushes off his hands.

"Come on. I know a shop that might still be open. I'll replace every single one, and if I have to do extra deliveries to pay for it, so be it. You can come along and make sure I don't get distracted."
